basic_info.full_name: DroneRF dataset: A dataset of drones for RF-based detection, classification, and identification
basic_info.organization: Qatar University; Tampere University of Technology / Tampere University affiliation for Mohammad F. Al-Sa'd in the data article
basic_info.citation: Al-Sa'd, Mohammad; Allahham, Mhd Saria; Mohamed, Amr; Al-Ali, Abdulla; Khattab, Tamer; Erbad, Aiman (2019), DroneRF dataset: A dataset of drones for RF-based detection, classification, and identification, Mendeley Data, v1. http://dx.doi.org/10.17632/f4c2b4n755.1

official_version_assessment.other_versions_found: No other official Mendeley version confirmed in this audit.
official_version_assessment.preprocessing_versions: Official code generates derived MAT files and processed RF_Data.csv, but these are not the same as the raw Mendeley CSV dataset.

data_scale.total_size: over 40GB according to the Data in Brief article; exact current Mendeley package byte size UNKNOWN
data_scale.number_of_files: 454 CSV record files by article statement; Mendeley UI/API file listing NOT_CONFIRMED
data_scale.number_of_samples: 4,540 x 10^6 raw samples by published table totals
data_scale.duration: 10.25 seconds of RF background activities and approximately 5.25 seconds of RF drone communications for each flight mode; total summed duration UNKNOWN
data_scale.number_of_operating_modes: 5 conceptual states: off/background, on and connected, hovering, flying, video recording; 10 BUI classes in official code/table
data_scale.train_validation_test_split: No fixed official train/validation/test split confirmed; related work/code uses 10-fold cross-validation.
data_scale.raw_or_processed_scale: Raw RF CSV scale; official code can generate smaller processed/FFT MAT and RF_Data.csv derivatives, but those are not the raw Mendeley dataset.

models: DJI Phantom / Phantom 3 reference in paper

bui_mapping_source_level.10010: Bebop mode 3 / flying without video recording
bui_mapping_source_level.10011: Bebop mode 4 / flying with video recording
bui_mapping_source_level.10110: AR mode 3 / flying without video recording
bui_mapping_source_level.10111: AR mode 4 / flying with video recording
bui_mapping_source_level.11000: Phantom activity / mode 1 in official code and common published summaries

operating_modes.mode_label_source: Filename BUI and official labeling scripts
operating_modes.notes: The data article example text and official code are not perfectly consistent for Phantom BUI examples; file-level validation is required before treating any filename map as verified.

rf_data_representation.raw_rf_description: CSV time-domain amplitude samples of acquired raw RF signals.
rf_data_representation.iq_note: Hardware has an I/Q sample-rate specification, but published dataset files are described as amplitude samples, not complex I/Q pairs.
rf_data_representation.spectrum_note: Frequency-domain spectra can be computed by DFT/FFT; official MATLAB aggregation code creates derived FFT/MAT data, but precomputed spectrum is not confirmed as the raw dataset.
rf_data_representation.spectrogram_note: No official stored spectrogram images/files confirmed.

containers: Official Mendeley RAR file objects for selected validation subset
Mendeley Data full file set / Download All
file_formats.one_file_represents: one lower-band or higher-band part of one RF segment; a full segment requires the L and H pair

labels.label_source: FILENAME / BUI plus official labeling scripts
labels.frequency_band: PARTIAL_SOURCE_LEVEL; L/H segment pairing confirmed, exact physical semantics and per-file frequency range UNKNOWN
labels.channel: PARTIAL; L/H denotes a two-part segment pair, exact physical path semantics UNKNOWN
labels.recording_id: YES via segment number in filename
labels.environment: WEAK via dataset-level lab/source location, not per-file metadata

license.commercial_use: YES under CC BY 4.0 terms unless additional platform terms apply
license.redistribution: YES under CC BY 4.0 attribution terms
license.modification: YES under CC BY 4.0 attribution terms
license.download_terms: Mendeley Data Terms of Use may apply; no separate dataset restriction found in source audit
license.code_license: Apache-2.0 for official code repository; separate from dataset CC BY 4.0 license

collection_environment.data_source_location: Department of Computer Science and Engineering, College of Engineering, Qatar University, Doha, Qatar
collection_environment.indoor_outdoor: Laboratory setting; exact indoor/outdoor field NOT separately labeled
collection_environment.notes: RF receivers intercepted drone-controller communications; mobile apps/flight controllers were used to change modes.

sensor_information.receiver_model: National Instruments USRP-2943 / NI-USRP2943R RF receivers
sensor_information.frequency_range: USRP receiver specification: 1.2GHz-6GHz; experiment assumes drones use WiFi at 2.4GHz and captures an 80MHz technology spectrum using two 40MHz receivers.
sensor_information.center_frequency: 2.4GHz assumption for the experiment; exact per-record center frequency UNKNOWN
sensor_information.sample_rate: UNKNOWN for actual stored files; hardware maximum I/Q sample rate is 200 MS/s and must not be treated as the stored sample rate
sensor_information.bandwidth: 40MHz maximum instantaneous bandwidth per receiver; two receivers capture lower and upper halves of an 80MHz spectrum
sensor_information.number_of_channels: 2 channels in receiver specification; two receivers used for lower/upper spectrum halves
sensor_information.recording_duration: 10.25s background; approximately 5.25s per drone flight mode; per-file durations NOT_FILE_VALIDATED

multimodal_association.reason: DroneRF is RF + text metadata/labels, not a synchronized RGB/audio/radar/LiDAR multimodal dataset. Its project value is knowledge-level association between drone entities, operating modes, and RF samples.
multimodal_association.knowledge_level_association: STRONG for RF file/segment to drone model and operating mode through filename/BUI and official labeling scripts; not sensor-level synchronization

sources.evidence: Official dataset page for DroneRF v1; lists DOI 10.17632/f4c2b4n755.1, contributors, CC BY 4.0 license, 227 recorded segments, 3 drones, background RF activities, RF receivers, and dataset description.

sources.source_type: Level 2 original Data in Brief article / open access full text
sources.evidence: Describes over 40GB raw RF CSV data, 227 segments, 454 record files, drone model table, filename BUI metadata, USRP receiver parameters, and collection environment.

sources.source_type: Level 2 original Data in Brief PDF mirror
sources.evidence: PDF of the DroneRF data article, including data scale, raw CSV format, acquisition setup, receiver parameters, and BUI labeling description.
Related research article: RF-based drone detection and identification using deep learning approaches; confirms public RF database and detection/identification tasks.
Author project page links Mendeley dataset, related paper, code repository, and dataset citation.
Official code repository with LabVIEW, MATLAB, and Python scripts; states the database is available on Mendeley and code is for RF signal detection/identification.
Shows BUI groups for background, Bebop, AR, and Phantom; reads raw CSV L/H files; applies FFT and saves derived MAT files.
Shows label construction for drone/no-drone, drone type, and BUI/mode class using derived MAT files.
Loads processed RF_Data.csv and treats rows 2048-2050 as three label levels. This is processed workflow evidence, not raw dataset format evidence.

knowledge_index_feasibility.reason: A stable record can link dataset, segment_id, BUI, drone_model, operating_mode, and paired RF L/H files.

limitations: Stored sample rate UNKNOWN; 200 MS/s is a hardware maximum, not the validated stored-file sample rate.
Exact L/H physical semantics and per-file frequency ranges remain UNKNOWN.
Only a selected official raw RF subset was technically validated, not the full >40GB / 454-CSV dataset.
DroneRF is not synchronized with RGB, audio, radar, LiDAR, or other sensor modalities.
Full dataset was not inspected end to end.
No FFT, STFT, spectrogram, embedding, filtering, downsampling, model training, or classification accuracy validation was performed.

project_readiness.notes: High-value RF modality source with strong entity/mode association. Use for RF storage, metadata indexing, and knowledge-level association, not synchronous sensor fusion.

validated_functions: Multimodal knowledge system at knowledge layer

final_dataset_evaluation.scope_note: VERIFIED for the project-relevant RF structure, label association, and file readability based on an official selected raw RF subset; not a claim that every full-dataset file was inspected.
